newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee motors up in switch-back ride.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee motors up in switch-back ride.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures motored higher by Wednesday midsession in line with pre-opening expectations with activity dominated by nearby switch trades.
Traders said the day's volume was 1,630 lots with September and November contracts accounting for 1,460 lots.
Switch buying was the order of the day, with Sept/Nov quoted at $10-$12 and Nov/Jan $30-$31.
September, which slumped to a six-month low of $1,477 a tonne on Tuesday afternoon, recovered to end Wednesday midday $60 higher at $1,565.
The market was called $100 higher on numbers on the back of New York's rally but traders said it could come in between $50 and $60 up.
New York arabicas rallied on the back of heavy speculative and trade buying on fears of a shortage of exchange-certified coffee for delivery against front-month September.
Sept/Dec switch widened after the failure of a large quantity of coffee posted for grading to be certified.
"From a technical perspective, the New York rally means little on the second month continuous series chart, but there is little preventing a test of resistance at $1.7850," broker GNI said.
It also said a rally today above $1,533 in London would suggest that the break on Tuesday was a bear trap.
